name: oanda-practice-readonly
description: Read-only OANDA fxTrade Practice tools: account summary, instrument specs, live pricing with spreads, candles, positions, orders, transactions, and the Master Handoff §16 connection audit. No order placement — by design.
long_description:
Read-only MCP server for the OANDA v20 PRACTICE API, built for the Claude London Trading Firm project.

Hard constraints from the project constitution (Master Handoff v1.1.0):
- No order-placement, modification, or cancellation tools exist in this server (§2: no LLM-facing order path — execution belongs to the deterministic broker adapter).
- The practice host is hard-coded; this server cannot reach the live host (§13 staging).
- The API token is provided via keychain-backed user configuration and is never logged (§17).

Tools: list accounts, account summary, instrument specs (min size / precision / margin rate), live pricing with spread in pips, historical candles, open positions, pending orders, recent transactions, and a one-call §16 connection audit.

api_token.title: OANDA Practice API token
api_token.description: Personal access token from your fxTrade PRACTICE account (Manage API Access). Do NOT use a live-account token — this server only talks to the practice host and a live token will be rejected with 401. Stored in the OS keychain.
